A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same TTP research, with readable text, equations, figures and tables. V1 includes supplementary Sections A–D; the supplied v2 ends after the references. This omission is an observable version difference, not an extraction gap.

before.justification: V1 reports original adversarial-detection, classification and robustness experiments across eight datasets and three CLIP backbones, plus ablations and supplementary threshold-sensitivity results.

after.justification: V2 retains the original detection, robustness and component-ablation results in Tables 1–7 and Figures 2 and 4, despite omitting the supplement.

M1.justification: Section 3.2 changes the ensemble's padded reference embedding from F(P_theta(x_adv)) to F(P_fix(x_adv)), specifying fixed rather than trained padding for this reference. The detector, entropy objective and aggregation procedure otherwise remain unchanged. The PDFs do not establish whether the implementation changed.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same eight classification datasets and retain PGD, CW, DeepFool and FGSM attack scenarios. The omitted supplement adds neither unique datasets nor attack scenarios beyond those retained in the main text.

E2.justification: Removing supplementary Table 9 eliminates TTC, Ensemble and MTA from the reported CW, DeepFool and FGSM comparisons on Flowers and DTD. Table 5 retains CLIP, R-TPT and TTP for these comparisons; all five baselines remain in the primary PGD comparisons.

E3.justification: V2 removes the reported threshold-sweep protocol spanning 0.6–0.9 with ViT-B/32 in Appendix C. Retained experiments preserve the three backbones, PGD-100, perturbation budget, AugMix, 64 augmented views and default threshold of 0.8. There is no evidence of changed test splits or sample counts.

E4.justification: Appendix C and Figure 5's investigation of detection sensitivity to the threshold across eight datasets is removed. Padding-pattern, padding-size and component ablations remain, as does the main multiple-attack robustness comparison, making this a limited contraction of the analyses.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, error bars or significance tests. Both present point estimates and dataset averages.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 1–7 are unchanged. V2 removes Figure 5's threshold curves and Table 9's additional baseline scores. One lost comparison is TTC's 56.5% against TTP's retained 56.4% on Flowers under DeepFool; CLIP, R-TPT and TTP results from Table 9 remain in Table 5.

T1.justification: The mathematical definition of the padded adversarial reference feeding Eqs. 8–10 changes from trainable to fixed padding, which is not equivalent notation. The remaining objectives and equations are retained, with no added or removed theorems, proofs or formal assumptions.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions and conclusion retain the same claims: a shared detection threshold, targeted trainable padding, similarity-aware aggregation, and improved robustness while preserving clean accuracy. Removing supplementary evidence does not narrow these claims.

C2.justification: V2 removes Appendix C's explanation that detection deteriorates when the threshold moves below or above 0.8 and its connection to embedding-similarity distributions. The main interpretations concerning attention restoration, excessive-padding distortion and cross-backbone applicability remain.

D1.justification: The abstract replaces a promised code release with an explicit repository link and availability statement. Conversely, v2 removes Table 8's dataset class and test-image counts and the explicit PyTorch implementation statement. Other reported hyperparameters and GPU details remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited research and substantive positioning remain unchanged. V1's separate preprint and conference entries for Szegedy et al.'s Intriguing Properties of Neural Networks are consolidated into one entry; other bibliography changes concern formatting and numbering.

P1.justification: V2 makes localized wording and cross-reference edits, updates an affiliation and corresponding-author designation, adds an acknowledgement, and removes supplementary Sections A–D. The main section order and most prose are retained rather than extensively rewritten.

P2.justification: Figure 3 corrects the swapped alpha/beta labels on the ensemble branches. Supplementary Figure 5 and Tables 8–9 disappear, Table 7 moves between columns, and text and references reflow. The remaining visual organization is largely preserved.

improvement.justification: The ensemble clarification, corrected Figure 3 and code-access link are useful improvements. However, v2 removes the only threshold-sensitivity study, expanded non-PGD baseline comparisons and dataset counts while retaining the same broad claims and main results. These losses modestly weaken evidential support and evaluation transparency overall.
